[[File:Kashyyykelevator.jpg|thumb|An elevator basket on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].]]

A '''liftcar''' or an '''elevator basket''' was a form of transportation that the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] used to travel between the relative safety of the upper levels of the enormous [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]] and the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] on their home [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Despite the apparent unreliability of such a contraption, it was surprisingly safe and efficient at carrying the Wookiees back and forth between their two destinations. These baskets were typically made from [[Wroshyr wood/Legends|wroshyr-wood]] and used woven [[kshyy vine]]s in their riggings. These vines, when healthy, were even stronger than [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] cable.

In the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] liftcars typically included repulsorlifts in case of emergency, although the strength of the vines made such situations quite rare.
